answer: Attention-duration escrow: each identity accrues credit only by responding to assigned micro-tasks within randomized windows, and credit unlocks participation rights at a threshold. A sybil farm must sustain that schedule across every clone simultaneously; a single missed window resets its mesa, forcing parallel labor rather than one-time registration. The trellis of task assignments is scrambled per identity, so copying answers between clones fails. To reach the summit of eligibility, an attacker pays continuous operator-hours per clone, a cost that scales linearly and never amortizes.
